name: ReordeRe Lite – Subscriptions For WooCommerce
author: Techspawn

sections.description:
ReordeRe Lite is the perfect solution for WooCommerce store owners looking to implement subscription-based business models. Whether you’re selling digital content, physical subscription boxes, or services, ReordeRe Lite provides everything you need to create, manage, and grow your subscription business.

💡 Why Choose ReordeRe? Our plugin is designed with simplicity in mind while providing the essential subscription features WooCommerce store owners need without bloating your site with unnecessary code.

🚀 ReordeRe Lite Features

  • Simple & Flexible Subscription Products: Easily convert any simple product into a subscription with just a few clicks
  • Customizable Billing Cycles: Set up daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly recurring billing intervals to match your business model
  • Secure PayPal Integration: Process subscription payments reliably through PayPal’s trusted platform
  • Comprehensive Subscription Management: View, track, and manage all customer subscriptions from your admin dashboard
  • Automated Email Notifications: Keep customers informed about renewals, payment failures, and subscription status
  • Free Trial Periods: Boost conversions by offering free trial periods for your subscription products
  • Customer Subscription Management: Allow customers to view, manage, and cancel their subscriptions from their account
  • Seamless User Experience: Optimized checkout flow specifically designed for subscription products

Upgrade to ReordeRe Pro to unlock the full potential of subscription commerce!

⭐ ReordeRe Pro Premium Features

  • Multiple Payment Gateway Support: Accept subscription payments through Stripe, PayPal, and other major payment processors
  • Variable Subscription Products: Create subscription products with multiple price points and feature options
  • Subscription Plan Switching: Allow customers to easily upgrade, downgrade, or change their subscription plans
  • Flexible Payment Options: Offer manual renewals, one-time payments alongside subscriptions, and more
  • Advanced Retry System: Customize payment retry schedules to reduce failed payments and churn
  • Comprehensive Subscription Analytics: Track key metrics like sales, revenue and subscriber growth
  • Import/Export Tools: Easily migrate subscription data or perform bulk operations seamless integrated with woocommerce importer
  • Early Renewal Options: Allow customers to renew their subscriptions before the scheduled date
  • Priority Expert Support: Get faster responses and dedicated assistance from our subscription specialists

Get ReordeRe Pro Today!

Differences Between Lite and Pro Versions

ReordeRe Lite (Free)
* Create and manage basic subscription products
* PayPal payment gateway integration
* Customer subscription management dashboard
* Automated email notifications
* Basic subscription reporting

ReordeRe Pro
* All Lite features included
* Multiple payment gateways (Stripe, Paypal, Square & More)
* Variable subscription products with options
* Subscription plan switching capabilities
* Advanced payment retry system
* Comprehensive analytics dashboard
* Subscription data import/export tools
* Early renewal options
* Priority expert support
* Regular feature updates.

Upgrade to Pro Today!

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/reordere-lite-subcriptions-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → ReordeRe to configure the plugin.
  4. Connect your PayPal account to begin accepting subscription payments.
  5. Start creating subscription products by editing any product and selecting the “Subscription” option.
sections.faq:
How do I create a subscription product?

  1. Go to Products → Add New
  2. Set up your product details (name, description, price)
  3. In the Product Data panel, select “Subscription”
  4. Set the subscription interval, period, and other subscription details
  5. Publish your product

Which payment gateways are supported in the Lite version?

ReordeRe Lite supports PayPal for processing subscription payments. For additional payment gateways like Stripe, please consider upgrading to ReordeRe Pro.

Can customers cancel their subscriptions?

Yes, customers can cancel their subscriptions from their account dashboard. You can also configure whether cancellations take effect immediately or at the end of the billing period.

Does ReordeRe work with WooCommerce’s tax and shipping features?

Yes, ReordeRe is fully compatible with WooCommerce’s core tax and shipping functionality, ensuring your subscription products calculate taxes and shipping correctly.

Is the plugin compatible with custom WooCommerce themes?

ReordeRe is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme that is compatible with WooCommerce. The plugin uses standard WooCommerce hooks and templates.

Where can I get support?

For Lite version users, please use the WordPress.org support forums. Pro users receive priority support through our dedicated helpdesk.
